name: medlit-cli
description: Run a stateful biomedical literature workflow with PubMed retrieval, open-access localization, evidence extraction, and report integrity checks.

interface.longDescription: Operate the bundled MedLit workflow from Codex: plan and run PubMed searches, fetch records, locate open-access sources, extract evidence, and create an integrity-checked report.
defaultPrompt: Use $medlit-cli to research a biomedical literature question.
Use $medlit-cli to resume a saved MedLit research state.
